verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a standalone terminal solution as "the quickest way to accept in-person payments," says terminals are managed from the unified Customer Area, and markets them as "get started fast." Terminals can be ordered via the Management API, and Tap to Pay needs no extra hardware. However, none of the evidence describes actually pairing or boarding a reader to a POS app or account, or shows that a first payment takes only minutes. missing for 10: documented terminal pairing/boarding steps, evidence of account registration of a reader, time-to-first-payment corroboration, independent hands-on confirmation.
